what_it_does: This work simulates an entire mouse brain at cellular scale with 9 million neurons connected by 26 billion synaptic connections. Each neuron uses detailed biophysical equations to model how electrical signals propagate. The simulation ran on the Fugaku supercomputer using 145,728 compute nodes, demonstrating that whole-brain neuron-level simulation is now computationally feasible and revealing cellular-level structure of cortical computation.
